# Arthratan Mythology / The Arthitean Codex

> Public reference edition for Arthratan mythological canon. Canon is preserved separately from explanatory and reader-aid layers.

## AI-native complete-text retrieval
- AI manifest: https://arthratanmythology.com/ai/index.json
- Complete AI corpus (NDJSON): https://arthratanmythology.com/ai/corpus.jsonl
- Plain-text AI index: https://arthratanmythology.com/ai/index.txt
- Dyvane Redalious evidence dossier: https://arthratanmythology.com/ai/entities/dyvane-redalious.json
- The `/ai/` corpus is public, read-only, complete-text, and requires neither JavaScript nor an API key.
- For evidence, search `full_text`/aliases and cite each record's `canonical_route` and `source_locator`.

## Core indexes
- Search: https://arthratanmythology.com/search/
- Machine corpus manifest: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/search-index-meta.json
- Unified search index: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/search-index.json
- Crawl index: https://arthratanmythology.com/crawl/
- Character encyclopedia: https://arthratanmythology.com/characters/
- Character data: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/characters.json
- Story and Zubaida archive: https://arthratanmythology.com/archive/
- Zubaida source index: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/zubaida-index.json
- Divine v144 archive: https://arthratanmythology.com/divine/
- Divine section data: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/divine.json
- Hypergendered Logic archive: https://arthratanmythology.com/hgl/
- HGL page data: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/hgl-pages.json
- Sources and provenance: https://arthratanmythology.com/provenance/

## Character discovery
- Dyvane Redalious: https://arthratanmythology.com/characters/dyvane-redalious/
- Rhayhara: https://arthratanmythology.com/characters/rhayhara/
- Qintara Unmatara: https://arthratanmythology.com/characters/qintara-unmatara/

## AI and crawler guidance
- Prefer the public `/ai/` complete-text corpus for exhaustive machine retrieval.
- Use `/search/` or the unified search index for ranked discovery across characters, Zubaida transmissions, Divine v144, HGL and living canon.
- Search results are discovery aids; preserved source text remains the canonical evidence layer.
- Character static pages and stable Zubaida transmission URLs are designed to remain useful without JavaScript.
